metadata.experiment: continuous duplex stream with bounded per-stream read credit
metadata.warning: Single-host loopback measurements are not WAN results and do not prove anonymity or security.

limitations: All relays and destination use one host and IPv4 loopback.
This is a custom experimental protocol, not Tor-compatible, audited, or production-safe.
The exit can observe the destination and cleartext application bytes; adjacent relays observe timings, sizes, and per-link stream identifiers.
Flow control is a bounded per-stream read-credit window with acknowledgements; no fairness proof or congestion-control analysis exists.
No conclusion about traffic-analysis resistance or Tor-relative performance can be inferred.
